name: Muc mot nang
summary: Squid dried under a single day’s sun and sold as the island’s gift pack. Mực một nắng Côn Đảo holds an OCOP three-star rating.
origin: Côn Đảo. Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025, and VOV, 6 May 2025.
culture: VOV says Mực một nắng Côn Đảo received a trademark in 2020 and an OCOP three-star certificate in 2024.
howToEat: Take it home as a pack. Fresh squid is the night-market plate.
where: Chợ Côn Đảo, the daily market in town.
seoTitle: Muc mot nang — one-sun squid in Con Dao
seoDescription: Mực một nắng is squid dried under one day’s sun, the OCOP three-star gift pack of Côn Đảo.
